Our Story

A Teacher, a Factory Town,
and 40 Orders

One person accountable for your order — not a call centre.

Xizeng · Founder · Baoding, Hebei

Who you're dealing with

I'm Xizeng. This started
in a classroom.

I run CrossPals from Baoding, Hebei — a city built around manufacturing. I'm a university teacher, and this business began as a lesson plan.

Baoding sits in the middle of some of China's densest industrial belts: hardware, textiles, kitchenware, packaging. I started taking students into the factories as part of their practical training — how a product is actually made, priced, and packed for export. The question I kept hearing from overseas buyers was simpler than any textbook: "Is this supplier real, and will the goods actually show up?"

So I started answering it — first for a handful of sellers, now for importers across a dozen countries. Over three years we've completed more than 40 orders: sourcing, inspecting, and prepping goods for Amazon FBA.

I still teach. CrossPals is what the teaching turned into — the same care I'd want if I were the one wiring money to a factory I'd never seen.

You deal with me — not a ticket queue.

Our mission

Make buying from China safe, inspected, and honest for every seller — whether it's their first order or their fiftieth.

What We Stand For

Four Values,
One Standard

  1. 01

    Trust First

    We only recommend suppliers we have personally vetted. Your money is safe because we treat every order as our own.

  2. 02

    Radical Transparency

    Supplier price, freight cost, our fee — you see every number before committing. No hidden markups, ever.

  3. 03

    End-to-End Ownership

    From first inquiry to delivery confirmation, one dedicated agent handles your entire order. We do not hand you off.

  4. 04

    Inspect, Always

    Every order is physically inspected and photographed before it ships — because "trust the factory" is not a quality-control plan.
